fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Holds the draw for 1.2 seconds, then looses a musk-dipped arrow at the first enemy within 10 tiles for 30 damage. It is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rank Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 musk-dipped arrows in a spread out to 8 tiles, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Downwind Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Stamp, Stamp, Loose
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
